findings.evidence: Roadmap `TauCetiRoadmap/IntegralLattices/README.md`, Layer 5 "Rank one": "For `⟨2m⟩`, `m≠0` … This example must compile for negative `m` as a negative-definite rank-one lattice too: the signature is `(1,0,0)` for `m>0` and `(0,0,1)` for `m<0`." The parametric form is the level the roadmap already commits to; the two frozen defs will be re-derived or orphaned when it lands.
findings.fix: Define `rankOne (n : ℤ) : IntegralLattice ℚ := ofGramMatrix (Basis.singleton (Fin 1) ℚ) (fun _ _ ↦ n) _`, prove `rankOne_form_apply : (rankOne n).form x y = n * x * y`, `rankOne_norm_apply`, `mem_rankOne_carrier_iff`, `isEven_rankOne (h : Even n)`, `determinant_rankOne : (rankOne n).determinant = n`, then set `aOne := rankOne 2`, `negativeAOne := rankOne (-2)` and derive the two acceptance statements.
findings.issue: `aOne` and `negativeAOne` are one construction at two scalars, duplicated six times: `aOneMatrix`/`negativeAOneMatrix` (54, 56), the defs (65, 73), `mem_*_carrier_iff` (124, 131), `*_form_apply` (153, 164), `*_norm_apply` (198, 204), `isEven_*` (223, 229). Every proof pair differs only in the constant.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Basis/Submodule.lean:189` `Basis.mem_span_iff_repr_mem : m ∈ span R (Set.range b) ↔ ∀ i, b.repr m i ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R S)`; `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/StdBasis.lean:131` `Pi.basisFun_repr`; `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Basis/Basic.lean:264` `Basis.singleton_repr`. No `mem_ofGramMatrix_carrier_iff` exists in the repo (grep over `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/IntegralLattice/*.lean`).
findings.fix: Add one lemma in `Basic.lean` beside `ofGramMatrix_carrier`: `theorem mem_ofGramMatrix_carrier_iff (b : Basis ι ℚ V) (G) (hG) (x : V) : x ∈ (ofGramMatrix b G hG).carrier ↔ ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℚ) = b.repr x i`, proved from `Basis.mem_span_iff_repr_mem`. The four example lemmas then follow by `Pi.basisFun_repr` / `Basis.singleton_repr`, with no `fin_cases`.
findings.issue: `mem_span_singletonBasis_iff` (96) and `mem_span_piBasisFinTwo_iff` (107) are the same statement hardcoded to `Fin 1` and `Fin 2`, then applied to give four `mem_*_carrier_iff` lemmas (124, 131, 138, 145) of which 124/131 and 138/145 are pairwise identical statements about equal carriers.

findings.evidence: `Signature.lean:179` `isNegDef_iff_sigPos_eq_zero_and_sigNull_eq_zero` and `Signature.lean:74` `signature_sum_eq_finrank` are exactly the two inputs the inlined `omega` argument uses; Layer 5's `⟨2m⟩` needs both signs of this lemma.
findings.fix: Add `signature_of_isNegDef (h : L.IsNegDef) : L.signature = (0, 0, Module.finrank ℚ V)` and its positive-definite dual to `Signature.lean`, from `isNegDef_iff_sigPos_eq_zero_and_sigNull_eq_zero` plus `signature_sum_eq_finrank`; then `negativeAOne_signature` is one rewrite.
findings.issue: `negativeAOne_signature` inlines the general fact that a negative-definite lattice has signature `(0, 0, finrank)`; `Signature.lean` has no such lemma (only `signature_sum_eq_finrank`, line 74).

summary: The rank-one lattice is entered twice as frozen constants (`[2]` and `[-2]`) with six duplicated proof pairs, where the roadmap's own Layer 5 pins the parametric `⟨2m⟩`; and the carrier-membership lemmas are hand-rolled twice for `Fin 1` and `Fin 2` instead of once via Mathlib's basis lemma. Both are special-case duplication of results the PR could readily prove in general.
